facts.business: Catvision Limited operates in television distribution, cable and DTH operations, hospitality solutions, and broadband network solutions including optical transmission products and digital distribution of linear and OTT channels.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The management expects improvement in the operational and financial performance of the Company in the coming period.

key_risks: Industry risk: Business related to broadcasting and distribution of foreign television channels subject to close government regulation
Company specific risk: High dependency on imports leading to currency fluctuation risk
Geopolitical threats: Wars affecting Indian economy, soaring input costs, and currency devaluation
facts.related_party_note: Mr. Syed Athar Abbas (Promoter and Managing Director) and Mrs. Hina Abbas (Whole-time Director) are spouses. Both have shareholding in the company. No other pecuniary relationships directly or indirectly with the company.
